name: The partnership
engine: Link each winger with the full-back on his own flank: a half win on a dribble or overlap there counts clean.
about: Four links, and a man has one partner. Porro and Yamal play on the right, Cucurella and Baena on the left, both linked Same side: on each flank their full-back is two against one, so a half win on a dribble or an overlap there counts as a clean win. Rodri and Olmo play give and go: after one passes to the other, the pass straight back is on. Fabián always looks for Oyarzabal. Yamal is captain and leads his partnership: his link works twice an attack, and when it is his own dribble, a loss counts as a half win. Link Porro to Baena instead and nothing happens: they are on different flanks.
